# Reflet

> Product feedback, roadmaps, and changelogs for developer-led teams.

Collect feedback through public boards and an embedded widget, organize it with votes and tags, prioritize work on a roadmap, and close the loop with release notes. Organizations choose which content is public and manage access for their team.

## Explore

- [Features](https://www.reflet.app/features)
- [Pricing and current plan limits](https://www.reflet.app/pricing)

## Integrate and automate

- [CLI documentation](https://www.reflet.app/docs/cli)
- [API documentation](https://www.reflet.app/docs/api)
- [SDK installation](https://www.reflet.app/docs/sdk/installation)
- [Feedback widget](https://www.reflet.app/docs/widget/feedback-widget)
- [Authentication](https://www.reflet.app/auth.md)
- [Agent skills](https://www.reflet.app/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [API catalog](https://www.reflet.app/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [Sitemap](https://www.reflet.app/sitemap.xml)

Public pages require no login. Organization administration requires a secret API key. Public widget keys cannot administer feedback. Private boards and dashboard data remain subject to authorization.
